required_documents.name: Grants.gov and JustGrants Application
required_documents.details: Official solicitation application submitted via Grants.gov and the JustGrants portal.

required_documents.name: Solicitation Narrative and Justification
required_documents.details: Detailed response to solicitation objectives addressing program scope and evaluation.

eligibility.summary: This NOFO is for specific invited applicants only. No other applicant is eligible to apply. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity O-OVC-2026-172807.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
